name: Sunset Glow by Amanatsu Mikan
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
As its name suggests, this recipe expresses a warm perspective reminiscent of evening light. As this recipe was created for warm colors, it does not go well with subjects or scenes exhibiting cool colors such as blue. The best results are achieved when shooting scenery that includes neutral greens. Enjoy the warmth of Sunset Glow to create warm and comforting photos of nature and cityscapes. 
When using this recipe for portraits, I recommend positioning subjects so light hits their skin to express the contrast in hues.
